row.team_price_text: Per-device licences via Meraki partners/resellers (no public price list)
row.evidence: Meraki's SAML guide says SAML users "will be granted whatever permissions have been assigned to the 'role' attribute included in the SAML token"; no SCIM endpoint for dashboard administrators appears in the Meraki documentation or the Dashboard API spec.
row.notes: New row. Scored the Meraki Dashboard (administrator access) as the provisioning target. No SCIM: Dashboard admin access is role-based IdP-initiated SAML (SP-initiated also documented), with no pre-created accounts (SAML users form a separate 'SAML user list'), so access is effectively just-in-time from the IdP's role attribute; Dashboard cannot receive SAML LogoutRequests. The Okta OIN app is SWA only; Entra's gallery app and the OneLogin catalogue app are SAML only. The Entra ID 'Organization Users' sync (Graph-based, every ~6 hours) caches end users for network access (Access Manager, splash, VPN), not dashboard admins, and is recorded in other_sync. Cisco Secure Connect (a separate SASE product) documents Okta and Azure SCIM for its remote-access identities; not scored here. Licensing is per device (Subscription, Co-Term or PDL) through partners/resellers, so no per-user prices exist. The Dashboard API creates, updates and revokes admins and manages SAML roles; SAML admins cannot use the API.

capabilities.notes: Users here are dashboard administrators; 'groups' are SAML roles. Role/scope is set via orgAccess, networks and tags on the admin record.
